description.p: Merisio is a modern MERISE database modelling tool built with Python and PySide6. Design conceptual data models (MCD) with a visual diagram editor, automatically generate logical models (MLD), and export PostgreSQL SQL scripts.

ul.li: Visual MCD editor with drag-and-drop entities, associations, and links
Sidebar with project tree, properties panel, and minimap overview
Automatic MLD (logical model) generation with customisable column names
PostgreSQL DDL export (CREATE TABLE, PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY)
Export diagrams to SVG, PNG, or PDF
Data dictionary with attribute overview across all entities
Model validation with detailed error reporting
CLI tool for batch processing and CI/CD integration
Customisable diagram colours and link styles (curved, orthogonal, straight)

screenshot.caption: MCD Diagram Editor with sidebar and output panel

description.p: Properties panel with Edit button and link cardinality editing. Native Qt widget rendering.
MySQL Workbench-inspired layout with sidebar (minimap, project tree, properties panel), central tabbed editors, and bottom output panel.
Man pages and --help/--version flags for GUI and CLI binaries.
CLI tool for batch processing, headless diagram export, auto-sizing entity boxes.
Zoom controls, diagram export (SVG/PNG/PDF), customisable colours.
MLD column renaming, link styles, project properties.
Initial release with MCD editor, MLD view, SQL generation, and project save/load.
